title: VESPER Knowledge / Project Map
description: SR-007: 'a mapping system INSTEAD of dumping huge volumes of tokens/files/code into context'. The map is the navigation structure consulted before retrieval, so that A-006 -- exact source spans from a large project WITHOUT loading the repository -- is achievable rather than aspirational. Authority: SR-007, SR-052, SR-053, SR-054; REM-010 §4.1; INV-EVID-2, INV-EVID-3.

root_ref.description: The corpus this map covers: a repository, a document set, a knowledge domain.

locator.description: A resolvable address -- a path, an anchor, a symbol qualified name. This is what makes a map entry ACTIONABLE: retrieval follows the locator to fetch the exact span, so the map itself never has to carry the content.

summary.description: What this node is FOR, in one line. A summary is navigation metadata; it is never citable evidence. INV-EVID-2: no answer cites a source it did not retrieve, and a summary-of-a-summary is not a retrieved span.

content_hash.description: SR-054 tier 1 (file hash). Also the staleness detector: a node whose hash no longer matches its locator is STALE and must not be served as current.

strategy.description: `incremental_on_change` is the STATE-class path: the map updates because the corpus changed, which is what makes 'keep the research library indexed' a standing goal rather than a nightly prompt (REM-007 §4.5).

coverage_ratio.description: Fraction of the corpus this map actually covers. Null means UNMEASURED, and an unmeasured map is treated as incomplete -- a retrieval that finds nothing in a partial map returns UNKNOWN, never 'no such thing exists'.

returns_spans.description: A-006: retrieval returns SPANS, not summaries-of-summaries. Fixed at true because a map whose retrieval returns prose is a RAG pipeline with a different name -- which is precisely what SR-052 ('BAG instead of RAG ... NO GUESSING') forbids.

span_reproducible.description: INV-EVID-2: every cited span is byte-reproducible from the source. This is what a similarity score cannot supply and is the enforceable content of 'BAG not RAG'.

$comment: EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: an embedded content field on a map node. If the map could carry content, the first implementation under memory pressure would populate it, and the map would become the token dump SR-007 exists to replace. The map holds locators and hashes; content is fetched on demand and cited as a span.
